items.question: Within how many days after the campaign completion date will the cashback be rewarded?
items.gold: Within 28 days after the campaign completion date.
items.fact: Cashback is rewarded within 28 days after campaign completion.

items.question: Can the REWARD11 promo code be applied after an order has already been placed?
items.gold: No, it cannot be applied retrospectively after order placement.
items.fact: REWARD11 must be applied before checkout; no retrospective application.
